(lambda greedy_coins, min_coins, sum_two_largest: stdout == 'canonical' if all(greedy_coins(x) == min_coins(x) for x in range(1, sum_two_largest + 1)) else 'non-canonical')(
    lambda x: sum(int(x >= c) for c in sorted(denominations, reverse=True)),
    lambda x: min(sum(int(x >= c) for c in denominations) if x == 0 else float('inf'),
                 min(min_coins(x - c) + 1 for c in denominations if c <= x)),
    sum(sorted(denominations)[-2:]))

The greedy_coins(x) function counts coins by always taking the largest possible denomination, and min_coins(x) computes the minimum coins via dynamic programming (recursive minimization over all denominations ≤ x).
